parameters.content:
## Scientific Writer (n8n agents)
Every step is an n8n Agent (SW · ...) with its skill from mcroitor/agent-skills-library and qwen3.8:27b.
Tools: Scout -> search_openalex, Analyst -> fetch_fulltext, Checker and Editor -> crossref_lookup.
Article language: English (default) or Romanian.

## Review gate
Passes at **70%** or more with **no critical issues**.
Otherwise the Editor revises the text with the Reviewer critical issues and top fixes, and the Reviewer checks it again. At most 2 revision rounds; after that the email lists what is still open.

nodeGroups.name: Research plan
nodeGroups.description: Planner agent (problem-decomposer) drafts the question, queries and outline; you approve them

nodeGroups.name: Sources
nodeGroups.description: Scout agent searches OpenAlex and screens papers (scientific-paper-analyst); you approve the list

nodeGroups.name: Reading
nodeGroups.description: Analyst agent downloads each PDF and writes a paper card (scientific-paper-analyst)

nodeGroups.name: Writing
nodeGroups.description: Synthesizer, Writer, Checker (Crossref) and Editor (ISO 690, BibTeX) agents

nodeGroups.name: Delivery
nodeGroups.description: Builds article.md, references.bib, review.md, sources-and-cards.md and emails them
